name: local-video-decodes
js: (function(){ const s = window.__hologram.status(); return s.mode === 'file' && s.live === true && s.videoWidth === 640 && s.paused === false; })()

name: sound-opens-cinema
js: (function(){ const s = window.__hologram.status(); return s.cinema === true && s.muted === false && s.controls === true && window.__hologram.screenVisible === false; })()

name: escape-closes-cinema-only
js: (function(){ const s = window.__hologram.status(); return s.cinema === false && s.muted === true && s.paused === false && window.__hologram.focused === true && window.__hologram.screenVisible === true; })()
